fields.name: celEntityNum
fields.comment: entity index in the same file, used when glistHashcode is -1

fields.name: placementType
fields.comment: 0x8000 static cel (0xc047 room, 0xc023 underwater room, 0x8019 object, 0x8017 water); 0x2000 without 0x8000 ignored; else Place_* object type

fields.name: rot
fields.comment: Euler; static cels draw RotMatrixZYX, objects View_RotTransMatrix

fields.name: quat
fields.comment: the INVERSE of the rot orientation (x y z w)

fields.name: scale
fields.comment: per-axis scale (AI volumes); (1,1,1) on every static

types.name: PlacementParam
types.comment: One {key, value} parameter of a placement record.

types.name: level_tag
types.comment: What every placement Create function receives (parsemap_block_map_data_dynamic 0xa66f0): zeroed, a 0x2C-byte header, then the placement parameters as dwords at 0x2C + 4*key. Per-type layouts: level_tag_<Type>.

fields.name: pathFrames
fields.comment: placement +0x40: frame count of the path; the header is filled only when non-zero

types.name: level_tag_Drone

fields.name: pathFrames
fields.comment: placement +0x40: frame count of the path; the header is filled only when non-zero

fields.name: skin
fields.comment: key 0. THE CHARACTER: AnimObjectNew(obj, skin) in NDrone2_DefaultInit 0x417f0. 0x05000000 = the editor template record in the shared pack (no such skin: skip). Level 0x07000014 (EvilBase) remaps 0x050000b1 -> 0x0500008c (that skin is not in the bundle). On some difficulties a "captain" swaps the skin by drone class (0x5000038, 0x500002f, 0x5000006, 0x5000093, 0x50000b2) - export the placed skin. (refers: skin 0x05 (bundle entry type 3))

fields.name: playScript
fields.comment: key 1. Drone+0x450. 0x06000000 = none. When set, the drone enters DSTATE_PlayScript at start (or after key 3 fires) and plays this ANIMATION script (DroneAnim_SetScript); 0x06000892 / 0x0600089c are special (cleared, set drone class 0x1c/0x1b). A good candidate for the exported starting animation. (refers: anim script 0x06 (bundle entry type 5))

fields.name: minDifficulty
fields.comment: key 2. Drone_Create returns NULL if key2 > GameState.difficultyModifier. 1 = always present; 2/3 only on harder settings - tag in the export.

fields.name: waitSwitchChannel
fields.comment: key 3. Drone+0x118 waitingForSwitchNumber. Non-zero: the drone starts DISABLED and HIDDEN (NDrone2_Enable(0): effectFlags |= 0x30) in DSTATE_WaitSwitch until the channel is set. 0 = present at level start.

fields.name: group
fields.comment: key 4. Drone+0x128 (NDrone2_SetupGroups 0x36e90 links drones by group). A DroneSpawner whose key1 equals this group removes these drones at level start and re-creates them later from their saved DIVars (same position). Also matched against DroneAIPoint key2 (NDrone2_ClosestAIPoint).

fields.name: mode
fields.comment: key 5. Drone+0x11c. <0x24: old fixed mode, index into the DroneModeSettings table 0x1776f8 (12 bytes: u8 class, u8 isCivilian(1 enemy,2 ally,3 civilian), f32 alertness, init fn) - 0 Normal 1 Guard 2 Retreater 3 Sniper 4 Stealth 5 Attacker 6 RunToPoint 7 Assassin 8 HostageKiller 9 Hostage 10 HostageTied 11 JustStand4Demo 12 DeleteMe 13 Civilian 14 CivilianScared 15 MissionFailer 16 Mayhew 17 Ninja 18 AlarmRaiser 19 SearchLight 20 Ambush 21 Zoe 22 PartyGirl 23 CivilianGuard 24 Interogator 25 CivDoorGuard 26 TruckDriver 27/28 CastleChatGuard1/2 29 SniperAlert 30 PartyGirlLooker 33 Bot (names from the PS2 table). >=0x24 (100 in all but one record): NEW behaviour block, keys 15-32 (NDrone2_DoModeSettingsNEW 0x41230).

fields.name: modeChangeSwitchChannel
fields.comment: key 6. Drone+0x119: when this channel is set, the drone changes mode: if key8 == 12 it is deleted, else it switches to attack mode (NDrone2_PreDroneControl).

fields.name: unknown7
fields.comment: key 7. Drone+0x12c, copied in NDrone2_CreateFromDIVars and DefaultInit; no reader found.

fields.name: secondaryMode
fields.comment: key 8. Drone+0x11e; index into the mode table (0 / 101 = none, 100 = new-style). Used by key 6.

fields.name: weapon
fields.comment: key 9. Held weapon at start: weapon_data variant index (0x18cfa0, stride 0x10c) -> animState.currentWeaponId. AnimObjectDraw draws weapon_data[w].wpn3rdPersonGfx (0x02 entity) at datum weapon_data[w].whichBone (docs/anim/spec-pose.md). 0 = default by skin (1, or 0 for 0x0500001e); 1 = unarmed. See weapon_gfx below. (refers: weapon variant -> 0x02 entity)

fields.name: drawWeapon
fields.comment: key 10. Drone+0x45: weapon the drone switches to when it draws (DroneWeap_ChangeWeapon on anim event 2); <=1 means it has none (DSTATE_DrawWeapon -> CivilianScared). Skins 0x05000026/0x05000066 force 6.

fields.name: grenades
fields.comment: key 11. hi nibble = grenade kind (1->weapon 0x36, 2->0x35, 4->0x34, 5->0x3a+count, 6->0x6c, other -> none), lo nibble = count; Drone+0x850/0x852. EvilBase clamps kinds 0x35/0x36 to 0x34.

fields.name: deathSwitchChannel
fields.comment: key 12. Drone+0x120: set when the drone dies (DroneFunc_SetDeathChannel). 99 = special: mission failed (killed civilian / cover blown).

fields.name: deathScript
fields.comment: key 13. Drone+0x858 special death/surrender animation script (DSTATE_SpecialDeath_Anim / Surrender_Anim); also records the start pos/rot. 0x0600021f is special. 0 = none. (refers: anim script 0x06 (entry type 5))

fields.name: combatRange
fields.comment: key 14. NDrone2_DefaultInit: sets the engage distances (1: 12-15 m, 2: 12-15/16, 3: 25-31 m, 4: 75-83 m sniper, 5: 12-16 close, other: 12-16/24).

fields.name: behaviourClass
fields.comment: key 15. NEW mode block start (behaviour_util_get 0x194d0 reads keys 15..): class/stats index (<0x11) -> Drone+0xab, behaviour_util_getStats(class) gives health, accuracy, etc.

fields.name: behaviour1Header
fields.comment: key 17. u16 word count (3) | u16 property count (0x5b = 91) << 16; always 0x005b0003

fields.name: behaviour1Props0
fields.comment: key 18. bits 0-31 of the first behaviour's 91 boolean properties (behaviour_util_getProperty(n))

fields.name: statsOverrideHeader
fields.comment: key 26. optional: 0x80010006 = 6 more words of bit-packed per-class stats (3 difficulty levels x 8 fields of 8,3,8,8,5,8,8,1 bits) written to the GLOBAL table 0x1d7830[class*3+difficulty]

fields.name: statsOverride0
fields.comment: key 27. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

fields.comment: key 28. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

fields.comment: key 29. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

fields.comment: key 30. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

fields.comment: key 31. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

fields.comment: key 32. bit-packed stats override data (see key 26)

types.comment: Placement type 15 (Drone) as Drone_Create reads it; confidence confirmed (skin, weapon, switches, transform); likely (behaviour block meaning); guess (key7). Object origin = pos exactly (not snapped), about 1.1 m above the floor (hip height: the exported skin glb has its feet at y = -1.16 in bind pose), so place the skin glb at pos with no y offset. rot is Euler radians; for these records only rot.y is ever non-zero (yaw). Engine object matrix = View_RotTransMatrix(rot,pos) 0xd92e0 = for yaw-only RotMatrixY(rot.y): model +z -> (sin y, 0, cos y), i.e. glTF rotation quaternion (0, sin(y/2), 0, cos(y/2)). The placement quat (+0x24) is the INVERSE of this (it equals (0,-sin(y/2),0,cos(y/2))) - do not use it for this type.
